tom (Product): Heads-up: were launching a small Dedicated RTX8000-ADA pool in sa-east-1 (So Paulo) as a controlled preview for LATAM customers. Go-live: 2026-04-20 14:00 UTC. This is Dedicated-only preview access. :brazil:

ana (Eng-Platform): Quick details: initial capacity = 12 GPUs (3 nodes). Console label = `dedicated.rtx8000-ada.preview.sa-east-1`. Reservations required for guaranteed access; well allow short burst for self-serve accounts but it's best to reserve for production.

marcos (Eng-SRE): Infra deploy scheduled; tags added: `rtx8000-ada-latam`, `dedicated-sa-east-1`. No expected control-plane downtime. Change scheduled by infra-bot.

infra-bot: Scheduled change: ADD_POOL sa-east-1 rtx8000-ada count=3 change_id=CHG-20260420-9911 eta=2026-04-20T14:00:00Z

ana (Eng-Platform): Reservation examples:
```
# CLI (example)
redwood reserve --region=sa-east-1 --gpu-type=rtx8000-ada --count=2 --term=monthly
```
API example (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/reservations -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"region":"sa-east-1","gpu_type":"rtx8000-ada","count":2,"term":"monthly","preview":true}'
```
Note: `gpu_type` is required; older clients that send `gpu_type":"rtx8000"` will map to the older variant, not ADA.

tom (Product): Pricing: intro preview rate = baseline RTX8000 price + 5% (temporary). Billing tag = `dedicated.rtx8000-ada.preview`. Were offering an early-bird credit for the first 5 enterprise reservations in LATAM (contact sales). No SLA during preview.

ops-lee: Reservation policy updates for this preview:
- Minimum reservation term: 1 month
- Cancellation notice: 14 days for full cancellations, 7 days for downsizing by <=50%
- Priority: enterprise customers with active Dedicated contracts get allocation priority
Exceptions by request (DM me).

marcos (Eng-SRE): Routing & fallback: requests specifying `gpu_type=rtx8000-ada` route to the new pools. If capacity not available, behavior depends on request flags: `allow_queue=true` -> queued, otherwise `INSUFFICIENT_CAPACITY`. Recommend client fallback `fallback_gpu_types=["rtx8000","a100"]` for critical low-latency paths. Add retry/backoff.

ana (Eng-Platform): Known preview limitations:
- Quantization profiles unverified for ADA variant; treat as experimental.
- Max seq length set to 6k tokens by default.
- No cross-zone live migration (single-zone only).
- Autoscaling may be conservative initially while we tune power and thermal profiles.

tom (Product): Canary plan: internal teams + 6 selected customers first. If telemetry (error rate, median latency, GPU OOMs) is healthy after 48h we expand. Dashboards: Console -> Dedicated -> Pools -> sa-east-1 -> rtx8000-ada.

marcos (Eng-SRE): Monitoring: well watch GPU temperature, memory pressure, scheduling latency, and pod preemption for 72h after launch. Pager rules: SLO breach or OOM spike -> page eng-oncall and tag @marcos.

tom (Product): Docs: internal doc and reservation flow will be posted to https://internal.redwood/docs/rtx8000-ada-latam by EOD today. Action items:
1) Teams wanting access, submit reservation via Console or CLI before 2026-04-18 23:59 UTC.
2) Add `gpu_type=rtx8000-ada` and fallback list in client flags.
3) Report any anomalies to #eng-platform with `rtx8000-ada` tag.

ops-lee: Oncall/Escalation: if you hit `INSUFFICIENT_CAPACITY` and need priority support during preview, message #eng-oncall and CC @ops-lee. Production-impacting incidents get prioritized for customers with reservations.

tom (Product): Thanks team  big win for LATAM coverage. Well share a brief exec note after 72h with initial utilization and customer feedback. :tada:
